snr.reference: on-air: the set SNR is the signal power at the channel input, after the transmit SSB passband where there is one (so the filter's loss does not count against the SNR), over the noise in 3000 Hz added at the receiver's antenna, before the receive passband
snr.signal_power_is: the mean over all 36 rungs of each rung's burst mean square (on air); each burst is scaled to exactly this power, so every rung meets the set SNR and every burst in one realisation shares one noise floor

ssb_passband.applied: sending radio and receiving radio, on the -SSB channels only

seeds.channel_seed: SplitMix64 finaliser over (channel index in AWGN, Poor, Moderate, AWGN-SSB, Poor-SSB; set SNR in tenths; segment; seed offset), one realisation per job
seeds.payload_seed: SplitMix64 finaliser over (channel seed, burst index in the job); bits from System.Random(seed).Next(2)

modem_settings: constraint length 7, 3 preamble super-frames, EOM and EOT appended, default demodulator options; one demodulator per job, running throughout

dpdu_layout.overhead_is: DATA-ONLY, address size 3 (nodes 0.0.1.1 and 0.0.1.2), header, header CRC and data CRC, from M0LTE.S5066.Core DpduCodec
dpdu_layout.rule: one long ARQ C_PDU to a known Ed4 peer, as M0LTE.S5066 TransmitQueue cuts it (C-0553, C-0870 to C-0872, interp C-1155): block aligned where a block holds a D_PDU, straddling whole blocks where it does not; the fill tail is not counted. A D_PDU is in error when any of its bits is wrong or was not received

estimate.source: Ms110dBurst.SnrDb of the decoded burst (the burst estimate), rounded to tenths of a dB
estimate.bin_is: the lower edge, floor(estimate / 5) * 5 tenths; - when the burst gave no estimate (not detected, wrong waveform locked, or no probe)

grid.windows: per rung and channel, CalibrationPlan.Window: AWGN from the D-LXIV AWGN SNR (+1 dB Ultra Short) -6 to +3 dB; Poor from the Poor prior -7.5 to +7.5 dB, Moderate 1.5 dB lower; SSB +1.5 dB at the top; each point adds the ladder neighbours (two each way) of the rungs whose window covers it

ladder_prior_is: the D-LXIV Poor SNR shifted by interleaver (Ultra Short +3, Short 0, Medium -1.5, Long -3 dB), then data rate; orders the pairs and neighbours only
pairs_are: every (a, b) with b within pair_reach places of a in ladder_prior, a itself included, both members of the point; each once per cycle (an Eulerian circuit), every rung the same number of bursts per cycle. Pairs further apart: from own.tsv by set SNR (the fading decorrelates in well under a second, so across the gap a burst's channel is independent of the one before; next.tsv carries the set SNR so near pairs can check this)

tables.own.tsv: per channel, rung, set SNR and estimate bin of the burst itself: bursts, blocks, block errors, D_PDUs, D_PDU errors, clean bursts (no D_PDU error) and half-failed bursts (D_PDU errors x 2 > D_PDUs, the corpus-format 6.2 halving test)
tables.next.tsv: per channel, rung a, rung b, set SNR, gap and estimate bin on a: pairs (a burst on b straight after one on a), then the burst on b's D_PDUs, D_PDU errors, blocks, block errors, clean bursts and half-failed bursts. Sum over set SNR for the plan's columns
